definitions.explanation: Having the darkest color, the opposite of white.

examples.japanese: {黒|くろ}い⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{黒|くろ}→黒：02205_kuro⟧く⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧。
{黒|くろ}い⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}て→着る：00541_kiru⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I wear a black suit to go to work.
It looks like it's going to rain. The sky is full of black clouds.

notes:
{黒|くろ}い is an i-adjective meaning black - the darkest color.

FORMS:
- Adjective: {黒|くろ}い (black)
- Noun: ⟦{黒|くろ}→黒：02205_kuro⟧ (black, the color black)
- Adverb: ⟦{黒|くろ}→黒：02205_kuro⟧く (⟦{黒|くろ}→黒：02205_kuro⟧く⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ - to become dark)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黒|くろ}い⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧: black hair
- {黒|くろ}い⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧: dark eyes
- {黒|くろ}い⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧: black clothes
- {黒|くろ}い⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧: black cat

RELATED COLORS:
- ⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧: white (opposite)
- ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧: red
- ⟦{青|あお}い→青い：00586_aoi⟧: blue

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧ is the word for a place or room that has little light. Japanese does not use {黒|くろ}い for 'dark' in that sense: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧ (the room is dark), not {黒|くろ}い. {黒|くろ}い describes the color of a thing.

USAGE:
⟦{黒|くろ}→黒：02205_kuro⟧ can also have figurative meanings like "guilty" (⟦{黒|くろ}→黒：02205_kuro⟧だ - guilty) in contrast to ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧ (innocent).
